'''Lenico IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lenico system/Legends|Lenico system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its barren surface presented ruins and others desolated places, like the [[Ash Plains]]. Numerous [[Space station/Legends|space station]] colonies such as [[Lenico Colony Blue]] remained in its orbit.

While the surface of the planet was supposedly dead, several life forms found refuge on the planet around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], including a small [[Ortolan tribe|tribe]] of [[Ortolan]]s, before they where massacred by the passing [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]].<ref name="Act 2" /> Later during the war, members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took part in a [[Battle on the Ash Plains of Lenico IV|battle]] on the Ash Plains.<ref name="TLS">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>
